name: dmon
reference: Tsitsulin, Palowitch, Perozzi, Müller. Graph Clustering with Graph Neural Networks. JMLR 2023.

upstream.note: The gcn.GCN and dmon.DMoN layers are imported unchanged; the patch is a single TF2 compat fix (add_variable -> add_weight). Training is run_dmon.py on the shared harness, not the authors' train.py.

architecture.doc: GCN hidden layers, one width per comma-separated entry. Paper (§5) uses a single hidden layer of 512 for all real-world datasets and 64 only for small synthetic graphs. Settable per graph class but excluded from tuning.

feature_kind.doc: Synthetic node representation used only when the instance has no real features.

learning_rate.doc: Adam learning rate. The paper (§5) deliberately keeps all hyperparameters constant and runs no tuning, so this is set-only.

collapse_regularization.doc: DMoN collapse regularisation weight. Fixed at 1.0 in the paper (Eq. 5); never swept, so set-only.

dropout_rate.doc: Dropout on the GNN representation. Fixed at 0.5 uniformly in the paper (§5); never swept, so set-only.
